Image

The Image component provides responsive, styled images with support for rounding, captions, overlays, object-fit variants, and placeholder states.

Basic Image

A simple responsive image that scales to its container width.

HTML
<img src="photo.jpg" alt="Description" class="zak-image">

Rounded Image

Apply border-radius modifiers to get rounded, circle, or pill-shaped images.

Rounded
Circle
Pill
HTML
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-rounded">
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-circle">
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-pill">

Image with Thumbnail

A bordered thumbnail-style image commonly used in file lists or detail views.

HTML
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-thumbnail">

Image with Overlay Text

Position text over an image using an overlay container.

Mountain Sunrise
Captured at dawn, 2024
HTML
<div class="zak-image-overlay">
  <img src="..." alt="...">
  <div class="zak-image-overlay-content">
    <h3>Mountain Sunrise</h3>
    <p>Captured at dawn, 2024</p>
  </div>
</div>

Image with Caption

Add a caption below an image to provide context or attribution.

Ocean View
Pacific coastline at sunset. Photo by Unsplash.
HTML
<figure class="zak-image-figure">
  <img src="..." alt="...">
  <figcaption class="zak-image-caption">
    <strong>Ocean View</strong>
    Pacific coastline at sunset.
  </figcaption>
</figure>

Use size modifiers to quickly control the image dimensions.

XS
SM
MD
LG

<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-xs">

Image with Border

Apply a visible border around the image for emphasis.

HTML
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-bordered">
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-border-dashed">

Image Placeholder

Display a colored placeholder while an image is loading or unavailable.

HTML
<div class="zak-image-placeholder">
  <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
    <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/>
    <circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/>
    <path d="m21 15-5-5L5 21"/>
  </svg>
</div>

Object-Fit Variants

Control how an image fits within its container using object-fit classes.

object-fit: cover
object-fit: contain
object-fit: fill
HTML
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-cover">
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-contain">
<img src="..." alt="..." class="zak-image zak-image-fill">

.zak-image-figureFigure wrapper with caption

Accessibility

  • Always provide meaningful alt text describing the image content.
  • Decorative images should use alt="" and role="presentation".
  • Image overlays must not rely on color alone; include sufficient text contrast (WCAG AA 4.5:1).
  • Captions wrapped in <figure> and <figcaption> are announced by screen readers.
  • Placeholder states should include aria-busy="true" or descriptive text.
